title: Retry a function that fails a few times before it succeeds
summary: Run 40 calls one after another, each of a function that fails 0 to 8 times before returning a value, under a policy of 3, 5 or 8 attempts with no waiting, and report the attempts each call used.
notes: An asynchronous task on one thread: each operation is one awaited call that makes 40 retried calls one after another. The function is trivial, so the figure is the cost of building a retrier, running its loop and failing or returning, plus what the runtime spends on awaiting. Waiting between attempts is set to zero; a package that cannot do that without a real timer is left out.
